author: Krystal
html: Thank you for all you've done. Your Meetup group really made a difference in my journey to tech. And best of luck to you!

author: David L McArthur
html: Best of luck to you! Much obliged for all your efforts --

author: Kel Vanderlip
html: I attended several meetups you organized. It was a great benefit to us out in sysadmin-land, getting a different perspective on our pesky and uninformed users. I hope Texas is good for you. Thank you - Kel

author: Brian Lau
html: Thanks Szilard. This was always the best of the local datascience meetup, well-worth the 4 hour round trips needed for me to make them.

author: Mike
html: Hi Szilard, sad to see you leave! Would you be interested in having someone (or a team of folks) continue your legacy and keep DataScience.LA running after you leave?
